picks.why: At 9.5x forward earnings with an 8% FCF yield and revenue +34%, HPE is the cheapest cash-generative way to own AI server demand, and it is still 7% above its 200-day while the Semis ETF fell 18% on the month. picks.risk: An 8% operating margin leaves little room if AI server pricing tightens or Juniper-deal debt weighs while hyperscaler orders slow.
